backup.body: A fresh install erases the internal storage. Copy ROMs, saves, screenshots and anything else you want to keep to your computer or the microSD card. Games on the microSD card are not touched.
backup.title: Copy your games and saves

backup.body: Charge it to at least 50% before you start, and keep the cable it came with handy.
backup.title: Charge the RG Cube

download_mode.body: Turn the Anbernic RG Cube off and unplug it. Hold the Back button and, still holding it, connect the USB cable to this computer. Keep holding until installation starts.
download_mode.title: Hold Back and plug in the cable

first_boot.body: When installation finishes, the Anbernic RG Cube restarts by itself and sets up its storage. Unplug the cable then.
first_boot.title: Unplug the cable when it restarts

first_boot.body: The first start takes a few minutes while Thimsy sets up your emulators. Don't turn it off.
first_boot.title: Wait for the first boot

first_boot.body: Check the buttons, touch screen, sound and Wi-Fi, and start a game.
first_boot.title: Check the basics

steps.body: The Anbernic RG Cube is unlocked once, on a Windows PC: the UnlockBootloader tool from GammaOS Next's installation guide (Unisoc T820, Steps 1 and 2) only runs on Windows. Install the Unisoc USB driver from the guide's UnisocTools first. Then turn the Anbernic RG Cube off and unplug it, start UnlockBootloader.bat and, within 30 seconds, hold the Back button and, still holding it, connect the USB cable. Let go when text appears on the screen. Unlocking erases the Anbernic RG Cube. The installer doesn't run that tool itself. Follow the guide, then come back and continue.
steps.title: Unlock with GammaOS's own steps

steps.body: When the screen shows INFO: LOCK FLAG IS: UNLOCK!!!, it's unlocked. Unplug the cable and make sure the Anbernic RG Cube is off (if it restarts, hold Power until it turns off), then continue.
steps.title: Check it's unlocked

first_time.body: Your Anbernic RG Cube still runs its original firmware. The installer walks you through unlocking it, then does a fresh install that erases the device.
first_time.title: First time installing custom firmware

returning.body: Your Anbernic RG Cube already runs custom firmware (it was unlocked before). Unlocking is skipped.
returning.title: Already unlocked: install new firmware
returning.update_note: Keeps your data. Only when the RG Cube already runs GammaOS Next 1.2 or a Thimsy build.
